set_interpretation: Five views of a visually consistent ziggurat, not five separately identified printed specimens.

identification.status: contextual and visual attribution to A2L X2
identification.basis: Semir identifies these as completed Bambu prints. Tier arrangement, quilted wall regions, lower woven transition and dense square roof agree with the A2L X2 preview and previous paired-print context.

images.title: Upper overview
images.reading: The roof mesh and several upper tiers are visible, with long curved strands around the transitions and part of the lower woven surface. The base is cropped.

images.title: Roof and upper wall
images.reading: A dense crossed mesh spans the visible top opening; the surrounding wall has regular repeated connections. Longer curved strands occur below and beside that region.

images.title: Lower woven transition
images.reading: A broad woven transition has repeated loops and crossing rows. Its junction with the adjacent wall is visible; perspective alone does not measure its angle or flatness.

images.title: Middle transition
images.reading: Long non-straight strands cross a transition above an open diagonal lattice and beside the more regularly woven lower surface. The image does not establish when the strands deformed.

images.title: Lower wall and junction
images.reading: Close view of an open diagonal lattice, curved bundles near an edge, and the meeting of wall and lower woven surface. The lowest wall and textured plate are partly visible.
